spans.s: पायगुण्ड, पायगुण्डे A learned pupil of Nāgeśabhațța who lived in Vārǎ- ņasī in the latter half of the 18th century A.D. He was a renowned teacher of Grammar and is believ- ed to have written commentaries on many works of Nāgeśa, the famous among which are the 'Kāśikā' called also 'Gadā' on the Paribhāșenduśekhara,the'Cidasthi- mālā' on the Laghuśabdenduśek- hara and the 'Chāyā' on the Udd- yota Bālambhațța Pāyaguņde, who has written a commentary on the Mitākșarā (the famous commen- tary on the Yajňavalkyasmŗti), is believed by some as the same as Vaidyanātha: while others say that Bālambhațța was the son of Vaidyanātha.
